* Own retention for your book. Every district renews every year, so you'll lead the value conversation first and the renewal conversation after, starting four to six months ahead of the renewal date
* Spot risk early and act on it. Watch health, usage and sentiment, flag at-risk accounts, and build and run recovery plans that get them back to healthy
* Build relationships at every level of the district. You'll join the implementation kickoff for new districts and get to know superintendents, business officials and transportation directors from day one, then keep those relationships strong with consistent, scheduled engagement
* Find growth opportunities. When a district's needs grow, you'll spot it and partner with our Sales team to bring the right solution forward
* Be the voice of the customer inside BusRight. Share what you're hearing with Product, Support and Implementation so we keep getting better for districts

**What You'll Bring**

* 3 to 5 years of experience as a Customer Success Manager at a SaaS company, managing your own book of business
* EdTech or K-12 experience is a big plus. If you've worked with school districts before, you already know how they make decisions, how budgets work and what the school year feels like, and that matters here
* A track record of retaining customers and driving adoption, with results you can walk us through
* Experience building success plans and leading business reviews or ROI conversations with executive stakeholders
* Strong organization and a habit of using data to decide where to spend your time
* Comfort working in Salesforce and a customer success platform
* Steadiness under pressure. Back to school (July through September) is our busiest season, and districts count on us to show up
* Ability to travel up to 15% of the time

**Who Thrives Here**

* You believe in Magical Hospitality, one of the values our team holds closest. For us, being responsive and kind is only the starting point. You anticipate what a district needs
* before they ask, follow through on the little things, and make every person you work with feel like they're your only customer
* You take ownership of your accounts and don't wait for someone else to fix a problem
* You're proactive. You'd rather pick up the phone and call a district than wait for them to call you
* You lead with curiosity, ask good questions and bring a point of view
* You like building things. We're growing quickly and putting new processes in place, and you'll help shape how Customer Success works here
* You see feedback as a gift and keep getting better

**Why BusRight**

* Your work directly affects whether students get to school safely and on time
* You'll join a Customer Success team that's growing and investing in how we work, from success plans to new playbooks and tools
* Remote work with a culture built on trust and collaboration
* Competitive compensation, equity and benefits

**Position Summary**

  

At Frontlion, the Customer Success Manager is the business owner for a portfolio of accounts. You are not a help desk and you are not a passive relationship manager. You carry a book of business, and you are accountable for its revenue the way an owner is: retaining it, growing it, and making sure every customer gets enough value from our platform that renewing and expanding is the obvious decision.

  

You are the customer’s trusted advisor and our commercial lead on the account. You run the adoption plan, the business reviews, the renewal, and the expansion conversation. You see the whole picture: usage, health, outcomes, and dollars, and you move the account forward on purpose. You report directly to the VP of Customer Experience & Operations.

  
  

**What You Own**

  

Your portfolio has a scorecard. These are the numbers you are measured on and the numbers you are expected to move.

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

**NRR**

  

Net Revenue Retention across your book. Grow the base through expansion and strong renewals.

  

**GRR**

  

Gross Revenue Retention. Protect the dollars and logos you start the year with
**.**

  

**Expansion**

  

New ARR from upsell and expansion inside your existing accounts.

  
  
  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  
  

Run your portfolio like a business owner

  

  
* Build and maintain an account plan for every customer: their goals, their health, their renewal date, their expansion path, and your next move to win the day, the week, the month, and the contract.
  
* Know your numbers cold: ARR, renewal timing, adoption, and risk, and bring a point of view on where each account is headed.
  
* Prioritize your time against revenue and risk, not against whoever emailed last.
  

  
  

Drive adoption and real outcomes.

  

  
* Lead onboarding and ongoing enablement so customers get to value fast and keep getting more of it.
  
* Run business reviews on a deliberate cadence that ties usage and results back to the outcomes the customer cares about.
  
* Maintain deep command of the Frontlion platform and roadmap so customers are always using it to its fullest.
  

  
  

Grow the account: upsell and expansion.

  

  
* Actively hunt for expansion inside your book: new sites, new departments, added products, higher tiers, and usage growth.
  
* Build the business case, price it, and lead the expansion conversation to close. This is a commercial role, and growing your portfolio is the job, not a bonus.
  
* Partner with Sales and leadership on larger expansions, but own the motion inside your accounts end to end.
  

  
  

Protect the base: retention and renewals.

  

  
* Own renewals in your portfolio from start to finish: forecast them early, reduce their risk, negotiate terms, and close them on time.
  
* Spot churn and contraction risk before it shows up in the numbers, and run the save play with the right internal resources.
  
* Defend GRR. Treat every renewal as yours to win and every dollar at risk as yours to keep.
  

  
  

Be the voice of the customer inside Frontlion.

  

  
* Lead escalations: pull in Support, Product, and Engineering and drive issues to resolution on the customer’s timeline.
  
* Feed clear, prioritized customer signal back into Product and leadership.
  
* Report regularly to the VP of Customer Experience & Operations on account health, retention, risk, and expansion pipeline.
  

  
  

**Required Qualifications**

  

  
* 3+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or B2B SaaS sales, owning retention and expansion for a book of business.
  
* A demonstrated track record of hitting retention and growth targets. You can point to renewals you saved and expansions you closed.
  
* Commercial instinct: comfortable talking price, terms, ROI, and business cases with decision makers.
  
* Strong business and data sense. You can read an account’s numbers and turn them into a plan.
  
* Confident, credible communicator with executives and operators alike.
  
* Fluent with CRM and customer success tooling; you keep your pipeline and account data current.
  
* Bachelor’s degree in a business or technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
  

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

  
* Experience in queue management, customer journey, or workforce/operations technology.
  
* History carrying enterprise and SMB accounts in the same book.
  
* Experience building expansion motions or upsell playbooks from the ground up.
  

  
  

**How Success Is Measured**

  

Your performance is read off your portfolio, not off activity:

  

  
* **Net Revenue Retention (NRR)**
  is the headline measure of whether your book grew.
  
* **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)**
  is dollar and logo retention across your accounts.
  
* **Expansion ARR**
  is new revenue closed inside your portfolio through upsell and expansion.
  
* **Renewal rate**
  is renewals closed on time with healthy terms.
  
* **Adoption and account health**
  is customers actively using the platform and getting value.
  
* **Customer satisfaction**
  is NPS, CSAT, and how referenceable your accounts are.

* Convert records for input into new systems
* Coordinate and train clients on an individual or group basis on use of system

* Consult with clients on best practices related to their business processes
* Supervise staff on projects and provide performance feedback
* Other duties as assigned

* Proven experience leading multiple Sage Intacct implementations from discovery, solution design, and configuration through go-live and ongoing client support
* Working experience with Sage Intacct implementation projects from discovery through go-live and post-implementation support.
* Ability to think “outside the box” and provide solutions to clients for various business-related tasks and analysis

* Ability to manage project budgets, change orders and timelines
* Experience working with manufacturing processes and inventory structure
* Knowledge of third-party applications that work with business applications and how to research application needs

* Strong Excel working knowledge

* Active Sage Intacct Certification (Implementation Specialist, Consultant, or Advanced certification preferred)
* Prior professional services experience
* Master’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field

### **Role Purpose**

Under the direct supervision of the Senior Project Manager, the Contract Management Officer is responsible for supporting the procurement processes and the day-to-day administration of contracts. The Contract Management Senior Officer will ensure that goods and services are purchased according to UNOPS rules and that, once signed, contracts are managed efficiently to ensure suppliers deliver on time and within budget.

### **Functions / Key Results Expected**

**Contract Compliance & Monitoring:**

* Serve as the administrator for contracts.
* Monitor the contractor’s compliance with all clauses, including insurance validity, performance security (bonds), and requirements.
* Track key contract dates, such as expiration dates, delivery milestones, and renewal periods to ensure no lapses in coverage.
* Ensure that service management is well structured, with understanding of the guidelines by both parties, and that suppliers understand the service they must provide and are provided with the information and contacts necessary for such.
* Contribute to the development of a comprehensive and objective performance management framework to be implemented when the contract is signed, providing incentives for the supplier to meet or exceed agreed performance standards.
* Draft communication to suppliers (other than technical) for the PM review and submittal Liaise with relevant UNOPS office to ensure adequate follow up on action to be taken
  

  

**Financial Management & Payments:**

* Manage the interim payment process certification by the technical team and document record/control).
* Ensure strict control over the project cash flow by tracking actual payments against the forecasted payment schedule.
* Maintain a complete financial register of the contract, including all approved payments, pending invoices, and retentions held. Implement the use of contract management software to record key information and to provide, for example, search capability so that ongoing contract management information and documentation is retained, managed, and easily accessible when needed.
* Put in place mechanisms (preferably technological) to identify key contract "trigger points" such as notice periods, health certificate and/or expiration dates of goods.
* Develop indicators and dashboards and maintain regular and ad hoc reports of contract management information.

* Liaise with relevant UNOPS office to ensure adequate follow up on action to be taken.

* Liaise with relevant UNOPS office to ensure adequate follow up on action to be taken.

* Ensure that contractual and supplier risk management is implemented with clear responsibilities and processes.

* Ensure that contractual terms around security and confidentiality (in particular issues related to the security/confidentiality of personal data), warranties, indemnities, insurance, and termination are understood and monitored by those responsible for the contract.
  

  

**Procurement Support:**

* Manage the purchase process: handling requests, evaluations, and review.
* Participate in the evaluation of technical and financial proposals from contractors and suppliers, providing specialized input.
* Ensure that the transition from the bidding/awarding phase to the contract management phase is planned and ownership is clear.
* Oversee the finalization and issuance of contracts and logistics.

The Security Technologies crypto team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer who is a technical leader, creative and committed to delivering quality software. This role is Hybrid in Raleigh NC, Boston MA or Lowell MA.

* Participate in the whole development cycle from requirements gathering, scoping, source code development to testing and verification
* Design and implement new features in cryptographic back-ends
* Improve and simplify crypto libraries API to reduce misuse
* Actively contribute to Fedora and Red Hat Enterprise Linux development
* Communicate and collaborate with developers and teams inside and outside Red Hat
* Influence the technical direction of their team and adjacent teams by building consensus in broader discussions with internal customers or through active participation in external communities
* Mentor and coach other engineers, share expertise by producing comprehensive design documents, writing blog posts, and mentoring others on documentation and communication best practices

What you will have
  
  

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a primary focus on cryptography
* Ability to work Hybrid in Boston MA, Lowell MA or Raleigh NC.
* C / Rust programming experience; professional or academic experience is required
* Knowledge of Linux operating system and its development tools; any distribution is OK
* Academic or engineering background in security engineering or cryptography
* Familiarity with TLS/SSL, IPSec/IKE or SSH protocol.
* Knowledge of PKCS#11 or PKIX technologies
* Familiarity with the use of crypto libraries like OpenSSL, GnuTLS or NSS
* Knowledge and proven experience in crypto algorithm or protocol implementations

**The Following Will Be Considered a Plus**

* Demonstrated ability to join open source projects and contribute
* Knowledge of Python
* Experience and passion in regards the AI-assisted development

The Red Hat Hybrid Platforms Product Management team is looking for a Principal Product Manager (technical) to own and drive identity solutions in Red Hat OpenShift.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In this role, you are responsible for how people, workloads, and software agents authenticate to OpenShift and how OpenShift decides what they are allowed to do. You will work with the Engineering and Product teams who build and deliver those capabilities. The product area includes:
  
  

* User authentication and authorization, including the OpenShift OAuth server and external OpenID Connect integrations, Kubernetes RBAC, workload identity, multi-cluster authentication on OpenShift clusters
* Identity and user federation to secure agentic workflows in OpenShift.

You will plan and deliver product content for new releases and launches, prioritize and communicate requirements to guide development, support the field in advanced sales opportunities, perform competitive reviews, and work with partners. You will contribute to company strategy and work closely with Engineering, Marketing, Support, Sales, Security, and Field teams.
  
  
You will engage with the open source communities behind this work, including Kubernetes and other Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) projects.
  
  
As a Principal Product Manager, you need great communication, teamwork, and persuasion skills to articulate the product vision, align teams across the company, and influence stakeholders. This is an opportunity to work on a core platform control alongside some of the brightest minds in open source.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Collect input from OpenShift users, customers, community members, and internal stakeholders on how enterprises manage identity, and turn that input into strategy and a roadmap
* Define the product vision, the customer problems to solve, and measurable outcomes for authentication, authorization, and workload identity.
* Define and use metrics for adoption and measuring success
* Research commercial and do-it-yourself alternatives and use that research for competitive positioning
* Prioritize and document requirements, epics, and user stories, with acceptance criteria, for new releases
* Guide major enhancements with OpenShift Engineering, Kubernetes upstream, and adjacent product teams.
* Drive the identity model that agentic features in OpenShift and related products use, and work with those product teams so agents obtain authority through OpenShift identity and authorization
* Work with Sales on customer inquiries, presentations, and demos.
* Support go-to-market work, including presentations, blogs, demos, workshops, events, and sales enablement, and review documentation for this area
* Keep Engineering, Support, and Field aligned on direction, and own the translation of strategy into a release plan

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of enterprise software experience in product management, technical marketing, solutions engineering, or a similar technical product or customer-facing role
* A track record of leading cross-functional work on a platform, security, or identity management, and of influencing people who do not report to you
* Direct experience with Kubernetes identity management.
* Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and or how enterprises use identity provider (e.g. Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Federate).
* Working knowledge of cloud workload identity. Depth in at least one of the following, and literacy in the others: AWS STS, Microsoft Entra workload identity, and Google Workload Identity or Workload Identity Federation
* A clear view of how a typical enterprise uses identity: single sign-on, group-based access, joiner-mover-leaver, non-human identities, and short-lived credentials as the default
* A clear view of how identity should work for agentic AI.
* Linux skills and direct experience with Linux containers and Kubernetes
* Working knowledge of the CNCF ecosystem and experience with open source projects
* Demonstrated ability to listen to customers, stakeholders, and engineering and turn that into product decisions
* Ability to handle several competing priorities
* Bachelor's or graduate degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Willingness to travel up to 25%

**The Following Are Considered a Plus**

* Hands-on configuration of OpenShift identity providers, OAuth, external OpenID Connect, or cloud credential modes used by managed OpenShift
* Upstream participation in Kubernetes SIG Auth or a related CNCF project
* Experience with SPIFFE and SPIRE, LDAP, or Active Directory
* Understanding of zero trust principles.
* Experience with compliance programs in which identity is a control, such as FedRAMP or PCI
* Prior experience with agile delivery and with Jira or a similar tool
* A track record of enterprise product launches

The Red Hat Hybrid Platforms Product Management team is looking for a Principal Product Manager (technical) to own and drive identity solutions in Red Hat OpenShift.

In this role, you are responsible for how people, workloads, and software agents authenticate to OpenShift and how OpenShift decides what they are allowed to do. You will work with the Engineering and Product teams who build and deliver those capabilities. The product area includes:

* User authentication and authorization, including the OpenShift OAuth server and external OpenID Connect integrations, Kubernetes RBAC, workload identity, multi-cluster authentication on OpenShift clusters
* Identity and user federation to secure agentic workflows in OpenShift.

You will plan and deliver product content for new releases and launches, prioritize and communicate requirements to guide development, support the field in advanced sales opportunities, perform competitive reviews, and work with partners. You will contribute to company strategy and work closely with Engineering, Marketing, Support, Sales, Security, and Field teams.

You will engage with the open source communities behind this work, including Kubernetes and other Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) projects.

As a Principal Product Manager, you need great communication, teamwork, and persuasion skills to articulate the product vision, align teams across the company, and influence stakeholders. This is an opportunity to work on a core platform control alongside some of the brightest minds in open source.

**What you will do:**
---------------------

* Collect input from OpenShift users, customers, community members, and internal stakeholders on how enterprises manage identity, and turn that input into strategy and a roadmap
* Define the product vision, the customer problems to solve, and measurable outcomes for authentication, authorization, and workload identity.
* Define and use metrics for adoption and measuring success
* Research commercial and do-it-yourself alternatives and use that research for competitive positioning
* Prioritize and document requirements, epics, and user stories, with acceptance criteria, for new releases
* Guide major enhancements with OpenShift Engineering, Kubernetes upstream, and adjacent product teams.
* Drive the identity model that agentic features in OpenShift and related products use, and work with those product teams so agents obtain authority through OpenShift identity and authorization
* Work with Sales on customer inquiries, presentations, and demos.
* Support go-to-market work, including presentations, blogs, demos, workshops, events, and sales enablement, and review documentation for this area
* Keep Engineering, Support, and Field aligned on direction, and own the translation of strategy into a release plan

**What you will bring:**
------------------------

* 5+ years of enterprise software experience in product management, technical marketing, solutions engineering, or a similar technical product or customer-facing role
* A track record of leading cross-functional work on a platform, security, or identity management, and of influencing people who do not report to you
* Direct experience with Kubernetes identity management.
* Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and or how enterprises use identity provider (e.g. Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Federate).
* Working knowledge of cloud workload identity. Depth in at least one of the following, and literacy in the others: AWS STS, Microsoft Entra workload identity, and Google Workload Identity or Workload Identity Federation
* A clear view of how a typical enterprise uses identity: single sign-on, group-based access, joiner-mover-leaver, non-human identities, and short-lived credentials as the default
* A clear view of how identity should work for agentic AI.
* Linux skills and direct experience with Linux containers and Kubernetes
* Working knowledge of the CNCF ecosystem and experience with open source projects
* Demonstrated ability to listen to customers, stakeholders, and engineering and turn that into product decisions
* Ability to handle several competing priorities
* Bachelor's or graduate degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Willingness to travel up to 25%

**The following are considered a plus:**
----------------------------------------

* Hands-on configuration of OpenShift identity providers, OAuth, external OpenID Connect, or cloud credential modes used by managed OpenShift
* Upstream participation in Kubernetes SIG Auth or a related CNCF project
* Experience with SPIFFE and SPIRE, LDAP, or Active Directory
* Understanding of zero trust principles.
* Experience with compliance programs in which identity is a control, such as FedRAMP or PCI
* Prior experience with agile delivery and with Jira or a similar tool
* A track record of enterprise product launches

As an Engineering Product Manager within the GSO Market Access Program, you own Cisco product management for offers delivered into the AWS TS region. You are the accountable extension Cisco Business Unit (BU) product and project managers and our end customers, and your job is to close the gap between what customers expect and what the BU actually delivers. You translate mission requirements, compliance and authorization obligations, and customer commitments into clear product requirements, priorities, and delivery plans, then drive them through the BU and GSO engineering teams to production.
  
This is an individual contributor role. The leadership it requires is product and technical leadership: setting product direction for the TS region, crafting BU roadmaps through influence and evidence, and driving standard processes across Cisco’s DoD and Government Solutions efforts, rather than formal people management.
  
  
Who You’ll Work With
  
  
You will partner directly with the GSO Principal Architect within the Security& Trust Organization’s Government Solutions (GSO) team, and work day to day with Cisco BU product and project managers and with customer program and mission partners. The role cuts across software development, platform and SRE, IaaS, SecOps, incident command, compliance and authorization, and the broader Cisco security portfolio.
  
GSO’s vision is to be the leader in delivering Cisco SaaS offers to the US Federal market, while attracting and developing top talent for an innovative engineering team. GSO drives this through a dynamic multi-functional team that collaborates in an agile setting and values every individual’s contribution.
  
  
Who You Are
  
  
You are a product manager who came up through hands-on engineering, not around it. You are comfortable turning an authorization boundary, a network topology, or a security control requirement into a clear, testable product requirement. You believe a product is validated by what the customer actually receives in production, not by what the roadmap promised.
  
You are critical about trade-offs and transparent about why. You lead BU and engineering peers through influence and expertise rather than formal authority, engage them directly rather than working around them, and can be relied on under pressure to keep the effort passionate about the right work.
  
  
Minimum Requirements (Required per OFCCP compliance)
  
  

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience with 8+ years of product management experience, or Master’s degree with 6+ years.
* Technical background working with engineering teams (software, cloud, or infrastructure engineering).
* Demonstrated ability delivering technical products within cloud platforms, SaaS, or infrastructure domains, including supervised cloud environments such as AWS GovCloud.
* Demonstrated success leading the full product lifecycle (definition, build, release, iteration, sustainment, and end of life) for sophisticated, distributed systems.
* Consistent record of driving delivery across engineering, operations, and business partners for large-scale platforms, applying technical leadership broadly across programs without formal people-management responsibility.
* Proficiency in defining and supervising product metrics to advise prioritization and demonstrate business impact.
* Must be eligible for a US Security Clearance (level to be determined).

Preferred Requirements (Required per OFCCP compliance)
  
  

* Ambiguity management: Outstanding ability to navigate complex, evolving problem spaces and drive transparency for the team.
* Influence: Strong partner leadership skills, with the ability to align BU and multi-functional teams without direct authority.
* Customer-centricity: A deep passion for improving end-to-end customer experiences through insight and develop thinking.
* Technical proficiency: Familiarity with automation, provisioning systems, and platform standardization initiatives.
* Communication: Excellent ability to articulate sophisticated technical strategies to both technical and executive audiences.
* Market analysis: Experience with competitive analysis and market validation, and identifying new market opportunities and adjacencies.
* Community and external engagement: Experience engaging partners, working groups, or open source communities, and communicating or serving as a product spokesperson externally.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code and delivery tooling: Terraform and Terragrunt, EKS/Kubernetes, Helm, Ansible, and GitLab CI.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking.

Job Overview  
  
At T-Mobile Advertising Solutions (T-Ads), we're building privacy-first advertising and data products powered by advanced machine learning, large-scale data processing, and cloud technologies. Our proprietary algorithms enable rich consumer insights, intelligent audience solutions, and measurable performance for advertisers while maintaining a strong commitment to consumer privacy.  
  
We are seeking a passionate, creative, and curious Senior Data Science Engineer to join our team. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of machine learning, software engineering, and big data, building AI and ML systems that directly impact our customers and business. You'll collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and deliver innovative solutions at scale.  
  
This role leads the end-to-end design and engineering of production-grade data products and ML systems. It translates ambiguous business problems into statistically rigorous solutions, applying appropriate testing, validation, and evaluation frameworks aligned to business metrics. The work you do will directly shape the future of our products and technologies across T-Ads.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Independently leads end-to-end delivery of data products or ML systems (includes technical decisions and production accountability).
* Frames ambiguous problems and evaluates multiple solution approaches; clarifies ambiguous requirements and proposes structured solution strategies.
* Designs statistically rigorous solutions using appropriate statistical testing, inference, and validation techniques. Identifies subtle data quality, leakage, and distribution shift issues
* Designs, trains, tunes, and deploys ML/deep learning models using established techniques with evaluation frameworks aligned to business metrics.
* Designs and implements scalable training and deployment pipelines using PySpark, Snowpark or similar technologies. Understands batch/streaming, distributed processing and cloud technologies as required for projects.
* Writes production-ready code in common data science languages like Python (including AI/ML libraries), SQL, Scala; enforces engineering standards including CI/CD and automated testing.
* Mentors engineers and provides feedback on models, pipelines, and deployment readiness.
* Collaborates across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* Authors technical design documents and leads design reviews.

**Education and Work Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree plus 5 years of related work experience OR Advanced degree with 3 years of related experience (Required)
* Acceptable areas of study include Quantitative Discipline (math, statistics, economics, computer science, physics, engineering, etc.) (Required)
* 4-7 years Industry experience in predictive modeling, data science, and analysis in an ML engineer or data scientist role building and deploying ML/deep learning models. (Required)
* 4-7 years Experience with common AI/ML programming languages (e.g., SQL, Python, Scala) (Required)
* 4-7 years Experience designing and working within big data architectures using distributed processing and storage technologies (e.g., Spark, Snowflake, Hadoop, Hive, Kafka), along with hands-on experience leveraging cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) to build scalable, reliable, and production-grade data and machine learning systems. (Required)
* 4-7 years Experience articulating and translating business questions and using statistical techniques to arrive at an answer using available data (Required)
* 4-7 years Experience working with relational and non-relational databases using SQL (Required)
* 4-7 years Experience in data visualization (Required)
* 2-4 years Experience in the advertising or similar industry (Preferred)

**Knowledges, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Critical Thinking: Ability to rigorously structure ambiguous problems, evaluate competing technical approaches using statistical and systems reasoning, anticipate failure modes, and make defensible decisions aligned to business impact. (Required)
* Mathematics: Ability to design statistically defensible evaluations, detect subtle validity issues, and quantify uncertainty in business-facing decisions. (Required)
* Machine Learning: Ability to lead end-to-end ML solutions, select appropriate model classes and loss functions aligned to business objectives, implement robust cross-validation and hyperparameter optimization strategies, productionize models via reproducible pipelines and CI/CD practices, and continuously monitor for drift, robustness issues, and system-level constraints (scalability, reliability, observability, and cost). (Required)
* Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python and PySpark, including extensive use of data science and ML libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn) to build scalable data and modeling solutions. Demonstrated ability to design and implement robust, efficient, and maintainable code using sound software engineering principles (modular design, testing, version control, CI/CD), including experience packaging and deploying applications using containerization technologies such as Docker, with working knowledge of Scala in distributed Spark environments when required. (Required)
* Communication: Strong communication skills, ability to work with cross functional teams (Required)

Represent FDE validated ROI outcomes in cross-functional senior leadership forums.

The Software Engineering for Audience and Measurement (SEAM) team builds the audience, identity, and measurement services that help advertisers and publishers reach the right people and understand campaign performance. We are looking for a Software Engineer that will deliver software, automation, analytics, and cloud optimization solutions that connect engineering performance with financial outcomes. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Optimization, you will be a hands-on individual contributor who partners across Engineering, Finance, Product, Architecture, Data, Platform, and SRE. * Support capacity planning, cost allocation, tagging, chargeback, and forecasting processes that improve financial accountability and budget accuracy across engineering teams.
* Develop automated unit and integration tests, troubleshoot production and data-quality issues, and ensure solutions adhere to engineering, security, compliance, and operational standards.

* LLM/RAG/MCP and Agentic AI
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically, 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience using languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript/Node.js, Rust, or Scala.
* Experience with at least one major cloud provider-AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI-and working knowledge of cloud billing, resource tagging, usage metrics, or cost-management concepts.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with microservices, containers, and orchestration platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes, EKS, or OKE.
* Strong SQL skills and exposure to data and analytics platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Presto, EMR, PostgreSQL, or Aerospike.
* Experience building dashboards, automated reporting, data pipelines, or observability solutions using tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, ELK, Grafana, or business intelligence platforms.

**Position Summary:**

Join our Food Services team and be part of an exciting kitchen environment! As a Line Cook, you will prepare delicious, high-quality food and ensure it is served quickly and consistently.

In this fast-paced job, you will showcase your skills while working under pressure. We focus on health, safety, and excellent customer service, so your role is important in meeting our standards. Work with a supportive team and bring a positive attitude to help create an enjoyable workplace for everyone.

As a Line Cook, you'll have the autonomy to excel in your role with minimal supervision. If you're passionate about the culinary arts and enjoy serving guests, this is the perfect job for you. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to showcase your skills and be part of a rewarding kitchen experience in the Purple Pear Restaurant.

**Key Responsibilities**

The Line Cook – Food Services reports directly to the Manager, Food Services. This individual will perform the following:

* Each day, begin by either opening or closing the kitchen according to our high standards. Ensure that all necessary supplies are readily available to create an exceptional menu for our guests.
* Showcase your culinary skills by preparing our delicious recipes with precision. Pay attention to portion control and presentation, serving menu items that consistently meet our established standards and practices.
* Take pride in maintaining the quality and safety of our food. Implement necessary sanitation measures when handling and preparing ingredients, ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene are met.
* Create an inviting work environment by keeping everything clean and organized. This includes taking care of walk-in coolers, sweeping floors, sanitizing surfaces, and properly storing food items. Contribute to the general maintenance and thorough cleaning of equipment as well.
* Work closely with the Manager to maintain inventory control. Anticipate and communicate potential shortages in advance to ensure a seamless flow of operations.
* Engage with visitors and coworkers in a positive and professional manner, fostering a warm and welcoming atmosphere.
* Master the use and maintenance of all equipment in the Purple Pear Restaurant, ensuring their proper functioning and longevity.
* Embrace flexibility by being ready to assist in various food service positions as needed, demonstrating your versatility and willingness to contribute to the team's success.
* Provide exceptional customer service by confidently addressing guest inquiries and offering valuable information about our facility, enhancing their overall experience.
* Be open to taking on any additional duties that may arise, demonstrating your adaptability and commitment to ensuring a smooth and enjoyable dining experience for all.

**Qualifications:**

Knowledge and Abilities:

* A passion and drive to create exceptional experiences.
* Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* An engaging personality combined with a strong work ethic and a positive attitude toward teamwork.
* Strong skills in identifying and resolving problems.
* Ability to stand and be active for extended periods.
* Knowledge of food preparation.
* Capable of lifting and carrying items weighing up to 50 pounds.
* A strong desire for personal and professional growth.

Education and Experience:

* Two years of experience in a fast-paced kitchen environment.
* Previous cash handling experience is a plus.
* High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.
* Food Safe certification is essential.
* Knowledge of food service methods and procedures, sanitation principles, and safe food handling practices.
* Demonstrated understanding of food and catering trends, quality standards, production processes, sanitation practices, food cost controls, and presentation techniques.
